description: Story 6 gold set (CAP-5). Written and frozen before the first scored run; do not edit after seeing answers. A retrieved review is relevant when its original review_text matches relevant_pattern (case-insensitive regex). Pattern counts were checked against the clean parquet within each question's filters, not against retrieval output.

questions.question: what do 1-star Pantene reviewers complain about
questions.notes: Headline demo question (story 4 query 1, judged partly). Relevant = names a concrete product complaint (hair feel, scalp, scent, hair loss), not just anger at the brand. The low band includes 2 stars; the filter cannot select exactly 1 star.

questions.question: Herbal Essences smell is too strong or gives headaches
questions.notes: Story 4 query 3, the known miss: the brand name in the query crowds retrieval toward generic brand+smell reviews. Kept verbatim to measure brand-name crowding.

questions.question: Does the shampoo make hair fall out or cause hair loss?
questions.relevant_pattern: hair loss|los(e|ing|t) (my |so much |a lot of )?hair|fall(ing|s)? out|thinn\w*|bald\w*|shedding
questions.notes: Story 4 query 4 (relevant). Unfiltered by brand, so answers may lean to one brand; not a brand comparison.

questions.question: Did the package arrive leaking or with a broken bottle?
questions.notes: Story 4 query 7 (relevant). Shipping damage, not product quality.

questions.question: Is Pantene safe for color-treated hair?
questions.notes: Story 4 query 8 (relevant). High band makes the evidence one-sided by design; an answer must not claim it is safe for everyone.

questions.question: Does Head & Shoulders actually get rid of dandruff?
questions.notes: Story 4 query 2 (relevant). Pattern is loose (most H&S reviews mention dandruff), so precision here is an upper bound.

questions.question: Which brand gets more complaints about residue or buildup left on the hair?
questions.notes: Comparative. Six retrieved reviews cannot establish which brand has more complaints; a faithful answer reports what the retrieved reviews say per brand and does not rank brands by frequency.

questions.question: How do reviewers describe the scent of Pantene compared with Herbal Essences?
questions.notes: Comparative across two brands with no brand filter; retrieval may return only one of the two brands. Pattern is loose.

questions.question: Is it worth the price or too expensive for the size?
questions.notes: Close to story 4 query 6 (relevant). Mid band (3 stars).

questions.question: Does Head & Shoulders cause an itchy, burning, or irritated scalp?
questions.notes: Brand and band filtered; smallest filter pool in the set (1,163 reviews).

questions.question: Do reviewers say the new Pantene formula is worse than the old one?
questions.relevant_pattern: new formula|formula change|chang\w* (the|their|its) formula|reformulat\w*|old formula|original formula
questions.notes: Narrow theme (126 matching reviews in the filter). Reviews carry no dates in the prompt, so an answer cannot say when the change happened.

questions.question: What do reviewers say about sulfates in these shampoos?
questions.notes: Ingredient mention as reported by reviewers; the answer must not add outside knowledge about sulfates.

questions.question: What are the most common complaints in low-rated reviews?
questions.notes: Broad theme question. Top-6 retrieval cannot establish 'most common'; expected weakness: thin answer or over-generalizing from few reviews.

questions.question: What do people like most about Pantene?
questions.notes: Broad theme question. Expected weakness: short generic praise ranks high (story 4 query 5).

questions.question: How much does Pantene shampoo cost in Japan?
questions.notes: Outside the corpus: regional prices. 'japan|tokyo' appears in 5 of 53,872 reviews and none states a Japanese price (checked by mention count only).

questions.question: Have clinical studies proven the ingredients in Head & Shoulders safe for long-term use?
questions.notes: Ingredient safety claim needing clinical evidence; consumer reviews cannot establish it. 'clinical stud|trial' appears in 1 review.

questions.question: What do reviewers say about the scent of Redken All Soft shampoo?
questions.notes: Competitor product outside the brand set. 'redken' appears in 34 reviews (comparisons), so retrieval may surface them; a correct reply still declines to describe a Redken product's scent.

questions.question: How did reviewers react to the Herbal Essences products launched in 2025?
questions.notes: After the corpus snapshot (ends 2023-09-01). Reviews in the prompt carry no dates, so the model cannot tell old reviews from 2025 ones; answering from any reviews is a failure.
